shortDescription: Change policy and state of SELinux

options.name: configfile
options.description: The path to the SELinux configuration file, if non-standard.

options.name: policy
options.description: The name of the SELinux policy to use (e.g. C(targeted)) will be required unless O(state=disabled).

options.name: update_kernel_param
options.description: If set to V(true), will update also the kernel boot parameters when disabling/enabling SELinux. The C(grubby) tool must be present on the target system for this to work.
